player_0.content: New plan: I failed to count the fruits in the last question because I didn't consider the possibility of a single fruit being mentioned multiple times. In the question "I have two grapes, and a plum. How many fruits do I have?", I should have counted the two grapes as two separate fruits, in addition to the plum. Next time, I will make sure to count each instance of a fruit individually, regardless of whether it's mentioned multiple times in the question.
